description: This is a Java source file defining the Manufacturer entity class, which models manufacturer data within the sales management system. It includes fields such as id, image, descriptions, and references to a merchant store, with JPA annotations for ORM mapping.

classes.name: Manufacturer
classes.description: Entity class representing a Manufacturer, with fields for id, descriptions, image, order, and related merchant store. Implements auditing capabilities and uses JPA annotations for ORM mapping.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the manufacturer.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for the manufacturer.

methods.name: getAuditSection
methods.description: Retrieves the audit details associated with this manufacturer.

methods.name: setAuditSection
methods.description: Sets the audit details for this manufacturer.

methods.name: getImage
methods.description: Returns the image URL or path associated with the manufacturer.

methods.name: setImage
methods.description: Sets the image URL or path for the manufacturer.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Retrieves the set of descriptions for the manufacturer.

methods.name: setDescriptions
methods.description: Sets the collection of descriptions for the manufacturer.

methods.name: getMerchantStore
methods.description: Returns the MerchantStore associated with this manufacturer.

methods.name: setMerchantStore
methods.description: Associates a MerchantStore with this manufacturer.
